2607.19020.title: Biological Amnesia in ICU Time-Series Prediction: A Drift-Adaptive Two-Stream Architecture with Temporal Retrieval
2607.19020.paper_summary: Background: Clinical decision support systems degrade silently as treatment protocols evolve, yet standard adaptation methods treat models as monolithic blocks, unable to distinguish stable patient physiology from shifting institutional practice. Methods: We propose an adaptive clinical intelligence architecture for ICU intervention prediction that structurally decouples physiological from treatment representations, confining parameter updates to the treatment stream upon a dual distributional and accuracy trigger. Automated audit logs record which treatment features drove each adaptation event and how their importance shifted. At inference, an attribution-driven Temporal RAG module grounds each prediction in patient-specific, era-matched PubMed evidence anchored to the patient's dominant physiological features. Experiments used 84,792 MIMIC-IV stays (2008-2022) under strict chronological split. Results: Drift localised entirely to the treatment stream, validating the structural prior. Selective adaptation improved vasopressor and septic shock discrimination and calibration over the static source model. A fully retrained baseline yielded marginally higher aggregate discrimination but missed 26 septic shock cases the framework correctly identified, with none in the reverse direction; retrieval consistency with the pre-adaptation source model was preserved by the framework but degraded substantially in the retrained baseline. Conclusions: Structurally constraining adaptation to drifting components while preserving stable physiological representations enables clinical AI to evolve with practice without distorting learned patient biology. This architecture offers a template for governable, interpretable deployment of adaptive models in high-stakes clinical environments.
2607.19020.paper_summary_zh: 背景：隨著治療方案的演變，臨床決策支持系統會悄然退化，但標準的適應方法將模型視為整體塊，無法區分穩定的病人體徵與不斷變化的機構實踐。<lb/>方法：我們提出了一種自適應臨床智慧架構，用於重症監護室介入預測，結構上將生理表徵與治療表徵解耦，將參數更新限制在治療流上，並根據雙重分佈和準確性觸發器進行。<lb/>自動審核日誌記錄了哪些治療特徵驅動了每個適應事件，以及它們的重要性如何變化。<lb/>在推斷時，基於歸因的時間RAG模塊將每個預測根植於病人特定的、時代匹配的PubMed證據，並與病人的主導生理特徵相連接。<lb/>實驗使用了84,792次MIMIC-IV住院（2008-2022），並在嚴格的時間劃分下進行。<lb/>結果：漂移完全局限於治療流，驗證了結構性先驗。<lb/>選擇性適應改善了血管收縮劑和敗血性休克的區分和校準，超過了靜態源模型。<lb/>完全重新訓練的基線產生了稍高的總體區分，但錯過了26例框架正確識別的敗血性休克病例，而在反向方向上則沒有；框架保持了與預適應源模型的一致性，但在重新訓練的基線中大幅下降。<lb/>結論：將適應結構性限制於漂移組件，同時保留穩定的生理表徵，使臨床AI能夠隨著實踐發展而不扭曲學習到的病人體生物學。<lb/>這種架構為在高風險臨床環境中可治理、可解釋的自適應模型部署提供了一個模板。
